title: Implement the argument surface, refusal codes and non-interactive contract
statement: Implement the documented flags including the explicit consent options, reject API keys as arguments, refuse on any missing decision in non-interactive mode, and publish the exit-code mapping in `--help` and in tests.
notes: ⚠️ NON-INTERACTIVE MODEL-USE CONFIRMATION IS UNRESOLVED (EVD-0128). selectModel refuses when it cannot ask, because --provider and --model alone do not grant model use. This task must decide how a fresh non-interactive setup supplies that confirmation. ⚠️ THE HELP MUST NAME --research tavily AS THE WAY TO ENABLE RESEARCH LATER (EVD-0127), matching the hint every user-disabled research outcome carries. ⚠️ DECLARED NON-SECRET IDENTITIES NEED AN INPUT (D22, EVD-0131). A model whose endpoint cannot be canonicalised or whose request profile holds unbounded inputs has no compatibility key without a declared identity, and setup and launch refuse it. This task's argument surface must provide a way to declare the endpoint and request identities, validated as non-secret labels, or such configurations cannot complete setup.
